scope: Continuation of q_277f20df4b6b47cc; Egr2-AS discrepancy, quantitative accessibility and neglected RNA/protein regulation. Human Schwann scope preferred, species and endpoints separated. New scoped task: regulator prediction beyond myelin program and independent perturbation validation.

items.question: Why do deposited Egr2/Jun RNA directions oppose a simple antisense repair-state model?
items.readout: Sample-level metadata, full transcriptome QC, source supplementary measurements
prerequisites: Audit material, source sample labels, assay endpoint and feature universe
items.finding: Fresh deposit matches inherited bytes exactly. Egr2 1.258x/Jun 0.820x persists under CPM and all pairwise comparisons. Protein/activity assays oppose steady-state RNA direction; cultures are not mapped across endpoints. Hemoglobin outlier mainly AS2, negligible effect on median-ratio normalization.
items.limitation: Source time/context supports a plausible explanation, not a demonstrated reconciliation; RNA, protein and nascent endpoints are not mapped to matched cultures.
items.next_action: Obtain sample-linked 48h nascent RNA, steady-state RNA and EGR2/C-JUN protein or clarify sample-to-figure mapping. Supplemental 2017 detailed methods blocked by two distinct routes.

items.question: What independent quantitative accessibility measurements illuminate PMP22 cis regulation?
items.readout: Per-sample counts or continuous signal with sourced assembly
prerequisites: Audit material, source sample labels, assay endpoint and feature universe
items.finding: 33,105 promoter/site windows evaluated; 3,288 >=90% observed coverage in both. Pmp22 common-base log2 tKO/sKO -0.447, -0.626, -0.718; RUNX site -0.111. Broad promoter median -0.450, so local reduction is not uniquely PMP22-specific.
items.limitation: n=1/genotype, differing DRG/tumor source labels and no matched genotype inference; independent of Egr2-AS perturbation.
items.next_action: Seek replicate-level same-context processed ATAC counts; do not use this experiment as replication of Egr2-AS.

items.question: Which post-transcriptional mechanisms explain RNA/protein divergence?
items.readout: Processed perturbation or kinetic measurements with RNA/protein endpoints
prerequisites: Audit material, source sample labels, assay endpoint and feature universe
items.finding: Computed all 670 selected co-IP entries (515 unique proteins, 40 in all variant lists); LMAN1, TMED9, ERGIC3, CANX among strongest L16P/WT shared-list enrichment differences. Source KO shows interaction not sufficient for trafficking control; UGGT1 acts despite not being detected.
items.limitation: Replicate-level reanalysis blocked: PRIDE SEARCH files 1.18-1.88 GB each, exceeding 512 MiB cap; selected summaries do not encode unlisted values.
items.next_action: Retain selected-list caveat; obtain small processed TMT channel matrix if available in future.

items.question: Are direct TEAD and EGR2-mediated routes distinguishable?
prerequisites: Audit material, source sample labels, assay endpoint and feature universe
items.finding: Full text confirms direct enhancer motif effects and developmental Yap/Taz effects. P20 Pmp22 Prom1 reduction with Egr2 RNA not significantly different supports separate route; quantitative mediation remains unresolved.
items.limitation: Study supplies TEAD knockdown, YAP/TAZ genotypes and motif reporters, but no matched EGR2 rescue/clamp. Reporter motif Figure 8 uses eight technical replicates; cannot infer fraction mediated by EGR2.
items.next_action: Need factorial TEAD perturbation with EGR2 rescue and endogenous promoter readouts; no amount of re-fitting existing separated assays identifies mediation fraction.

items.question: What human evidence transfers to promoter/copy-number regulation?
prerequisites: Audit material, source sample labels, assay endpoint and feature universe
items.finding: 12 arrays/7 donors; BAR duplication and JIM L16P each one donor. Source log10 ratios/channel intensities confirmed. Two PMP22 probes yield 25.6x vs2.66x BAR/normal; broad BAR/JIM contrast correlation .812.
items.limitation: Donor, culture, nerve site and mutation cannot be separated; no promoter-resolved dosage coefficient.
items.next_action: Need independent duplication/control donors, probe sequence/isoform validation and endogenous P1/P2 readouts.

items.question: What reciprocal PMP22/ABCA1 protein relationship is measured, and does it establish transcriptional feedback?
items.readout: independent metabolic perturbation with PMP22 endpoint
prerequisites: Audit material, source sample labels, assay endpoint and feature universe
items.finding: Source total PMP22 in ABCA1KO rises1.53x while endoH-resistant fraction falls81.9% to52.2%. Executed summary-product reconstruction yields resistant index.975, illustrating total versus processed endpoint distinction; not a paired measurement or formal null.
items.limitation: Replicate covariance and promoter/RNA response to ABCA1loss absent from these endpoints; lipid-to-transcription feedback not demonstrated.
items.next_action: Acquire paired per-animal RNA, total/processed protein and independent cholesterol perturbation before asserting a closed feedback loop.

items.question: Does Egr2-AS change quantitative promoter accessibility?
items.readout: Per-library promoter counts or continuous tracks
prerequisites: Audit material, sample identity and endpoint
items.limitation: GEO supplies four narrowPeak lists, not promoter count matrix described in Methods. Superseries Hi-C matrices are a different assay. Supplement has IGV images; pinned GitHub tree supplies scripts, not the matrix.
items.next_action: Request processed featureCounts promoter matrix and sample metadata; raw ATAC processing requires separate scope.

items.question: What controls endogenous miR29 biogenesis and AGO loading across injury?
items.readout: Matched miRNA/AGO-bound PMP22 and upstream perturbation
prerequisites: Audit material, sample identity and endpoint
items.finding: Upstream state dependence is supported; exact production versus loading contribution remains unidentified.
items.limitation: Primary paper measures growth-state miRNA, Dicer perturbation and engineered AGO2/miR29 coexpression; no same-sample endogenous injury AGO loading matrix. Ten nerve samples pooled for injury, so technical triplicates cannot estimate between-animal loading variance.
items.next_action: Locate independent small-RNA plus AGO-IP/CLIP with matched injury state, or obtain underlying culture microarray matrix before broad reanalysis.

items.question: Does G3BP1 act through PMP22 RNA half-life?
prerequisites: Audit material, sample identity and endpoint
items.finding: RNA induction accompanied by source mean half-lives4.4h control/4.2h siG3BP1; no demonstrated stabilization mechanism.
items.limitation: MCF7 cancer cells; selected array contrasts and source summary kinetics; not a Schwann transfer.
items.next_action: Test matched nascent transcription and decay in appropriate Schwann material.

items.question: Does dosage RNA predict myelin-localized endogenous protein?
items.readout: Matched human RNA, synthesis/decay and localization
prerequisites: Audit material, sample identity and endpoint
items.limitation: Human GSE7423 measures proliferating-culture RNA only; protein study uses tagged HEK293 constructs with selected co-IP. These materials cannot be paired into a human dosage-to-functional-protein estimate.
items.next_action: Acquire a donor-matched human Schwann RNA/protein/localization series; retain variant-specific predictions.

items.question: Do processed bulk RNA measurements support the reported Pmp22 response and contextualize lower ATAC signal?
items.readout: GSE122774 processed RNA counts and sample metadata
prerequisites: Verify n3 genotype mapping; bulk versus sorted material; count semantics
items.finding: 24,062 gene rows; Pmp22 2.308x median-ratio and2.207xCPM; all9 pairwise increases. Mpz2.820x/Mbp2.475x; Egr2/Sox10 smaller with pairwise ranges crossing1. Within-group sample-title/file-header swaps identified and preserved.
items.limitation: Bulk RNA tissue annotations and genotype detail differ across GEO/paper; n3 does not remove tissue/state confounding. No transcript count matrix or cross-assay animal identity.
items.next_action: Clarify sample map and obtain Kallisto transcript abundances to test P1/P2 estimates; do not pair bulkRNA to sortedATAC by label guesswork.
